entries.name: original_merge_double_write
entries.sql: WITH source_rows AS (UPDATE usage_records SET status = 'ready' RETURNING id, status) MERGE INTO usage_records USING source_rows ON usage_records.id = source_rows.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status = source_rows.status

entries.name: disjoint_merge
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id,status) MERGE INTO usage_records t USING changed s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status=s.status

entries.name: unused_update
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT 7 AS answer

entries.name: zero_demand
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM changed LIMIT 0

entries.name: snapshot_and_returning
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id,status) SELECT old.id,old.status,changed.status FROM source_records old JOIN changed ON old.id=changed.id ORDER BY old.id

entries.name: shared_volatile_producer
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id,v) SELECT a.id,a.v,b.v FROM changed a JOIN changed b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: dependent_mutations
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id,status), copied AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) SELECT id,status FROM changed RETURNING id,status) SELECT id,status FROM copied ORDER BY id

entries.name: no_returning_unused
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready') SELECT 7 AS answer

entries.name: no_returning_reference
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready') SELECT * FROM changed

entries.name: nested_write
entries.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT * FROM changed) q

entries.name: recursive_write
entries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' FROM changed c WHERE source_records.id=c.id RETURNING source_records.id) SELECT * FROM changed

entries.name: rollback_all
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) UPDATE usage_records SET v=1/(v-v) WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM changed)

entries.name: same_target_update
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE usage_records SET v=v+1 RETURNING id) UPDATE usage_records SET v=v+10 WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM changed) RETURNING id,v

entries.name: same_target_delete
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE usage_records SET v=v+1 RETURNING id) DELETE FROM usage_records WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM changed) RETURNING id,v

entries.name: own_insert_upsert
entries.sql: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','first') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','second') ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status RETURNING id,status

entries.name: own_insert_upsert_false
entries.sql: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','first') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','second') ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status WHERE false RETURNING id,status

entries.name: own_insert_do_nothing
entries.sql: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','first') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','second') ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,status

entries.name: own_insert_duplicate
entries.sql: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','first') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) VALUES('x','second') RETURNING id,status

entries.name: delete_producer
entries.sql: WITH deleted AS (DELETE FROM source_records WHERE id='a' RETURNING id,status) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,status) SELECT id,status FROM deleted RETURNING id,status

entries.name: merge_producer
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO usage_records t USING source_records s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status='merged' RETURNING t.id,t.status) SELECT id,status FROM changed ORDER BY id

entries.name: typed_capture
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET n=n+0.0001 RETURNING id,a,n) SELECT a.id,a.a,a.n,b.n FROM changed a JOIN changed b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: fk_child_then_parent
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO fk_children VALUES ('new-child','new-parent','new') RETURNING parent_id) INSERT INTO fk_parents SELECT parent_id FROM added RETURNING id

entries.name: fk_delete_then_child_update
entries.sql: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM fk_parents WHERE id='a' RETURNING id) UPDATE fk_children SET status='seen' WHERE parent_id IN(SELECT id FROM removed) RETURNING id,status

entries.name: fk_delete_then_parent_reinsert
entries.sql: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM fk_parents WHERE id='a' RETURNING id) INSERT INTO fk_parents SELECT id FROM removed RETURNING id

entries.name: referenced_own_insert_upsert
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO fk_parents VALUES ('new') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO fk_parents SELECT id FROM added ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET id=excluded.id RETURNING id

entries.name: referenced_own_insert_do_nothing
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO fk_parents VALUES ('new') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO fk_parents SELECT id FROM added ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

entries.name: shared_read_with_mutation
entries.sql: WITH old AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,status FROM source_records), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT a.id,a.status,b.status FROM old a JOIN old b USING(id) JOIN changed USING(id) ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: inlined_read_with_mutation
entries.sql: WITH old AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,status FROM source_records), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT old.id,old.status FROM old JOIN changed USING(id) ORDER BY old.id

entries.name: volatile_read_not_materialized
entries.sql: WITH sampled AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,nextval('effect_sequence') v FROM source_records), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT a.id,a.v,b.v FROM sampled a JOIN sampled b USING(id) JOIN changed USING(id) ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: recursive_read_with_mutation
entries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE numbers(n) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM numbers WHERE n<3), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT n FROM numbers ORDER BY n

entries.name: read_shadow_scope
entries.sql: WITH outer_read AS (SELECT id FROM source_records), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET status='ready' RETURNING id) SELECT old.id FROM (WITH outer_read AS (SELECT id FROM archived_records) SELECT id FROM outer_read) old JOIN changed USING(id)

entries.name: plan_insert_source_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,1/0 FROM changed

entries.name: plan_insert_values_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('new',1/0)

entries.name: plan_update_false_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) UPDATE usage_records SET v=1/0 WHERE false

entries.name: plan_select_limit_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) SELECT 1/0 FROM changed LIMIT 0

entries.name: plan_unused_read_error
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (SELECT 1/0), changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM changed

entries.name: plan_inactive_merge_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) MERGE INTO usage_records t USING changed s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED AND false THEN UPDATE SET v=1/0

entries.name: plan_false_conflict_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id) INSERT INTO usage_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM changed ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET v=1/0 WHERE false RETURNING id

entries.name: plan_false_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id), invalid AS (UPDATE usage_records SET v=2 WHERE false RETURNING 1/0) SELECT 7

entries.name: updated_owner_upsert
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=v+1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO source_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM changed ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v RETURNING id,v

entries.name: updated_owner_false_upsert
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=v+1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO source_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM changed ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v WHERE false RETURNING id,v

entries.name: updated_owner_do_nothing
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=v+1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO source_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM changed ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,v

entries.name: retired_owner_upsert
entries.sql: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM source_records RETURNING id) INSERT INTO source_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM removed ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v RETURNING id,v

entries.name: retired_owner_do_nothing
entries.sql: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM source_records RETURNING id) INSERT INTO source_records(id,v) SELECT id,2 FROM removed ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,v

entries.name: mutation_error_interleaving
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING v) SELECT v/(v-v) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=v RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') AS n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_delete_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (DELETE FROM source_records RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') AS n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_mutation_limit_one
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM changed LIMIT 1

entries.name: ordered_mutation_limit_zero
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM changed LIMIT 0

entries.name: ordered_unused_no_returning
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence')) SELECT 7

entries.name: ordered_shared_returning
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id,v) SELECT a.id,a.v,b.v FROM changed a JOIN changed b USING(id) ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: ordered_root_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING v/(v-v)

entries.name: ordered_root_returning
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING v

entries.name: ordered_insert_values_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('d',nextval('effect_sequence')) RETURNING v) SELECT v/(v-v) FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',1),('d',2) RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_source_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,nextval('effect_sequence') FROM source_records RETURNING v) SELECT v/(v-v) FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_source_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,v FROM source_records RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_limit_zero
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('d',nextval('effect_sequence')) RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added LIMIT 0

entries.name: ordered_insert_limit_one
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,nextval('effect_sequence') FROM source_records RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added LIMIT 1

entries.name: ordered_insert_unused
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,nextval('effect_sequence') FROM source_records) SELECT 7

entries.name: ordered_insert_root_error
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('d',nextval('effect_sequence')) RETURNING v/(v-v)

entries.name: ordered_insert_root
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT id,nextval('effect_sequence') FROM source_records RETURNING v

entries.name: ordered_insert_duplicate_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('d',nextval('effect_sequence')) RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_source_duplicate_error
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) SELECT 'c',nextval('effect_sequence') FROM source_records RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added

entries.name: ordered_merge_update_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v) SELECT v/(v-v) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_merge_returning_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=t.v RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_merge_delete_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE RETURNING nextval('effect_sequence') n) SELECT n/(n-n) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_merge_insert_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('c'),('d')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,v) VALUES(s.k,nextval('effect_sequence')) RETURNING t.v) SELECT v/(v-v) FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_merge_limit_zero
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v) SELECT v FROM changed LIMIT 0

entries.name: ordered_merge_limit_one
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v) SELECT v FROM changed LIMIT 1

entries.name: ordered_merge_unused
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence')) SELECT 7

entries.name: ordered_merge_root_error
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v/(t.v-t.v)

entries.name: ordered_merge_root
entries.sql: WITH unused AS (UPDATE archived_records SET v=v WHERE false) MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('b')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v

entries.name: ordered_merge_duplicate_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (MERGE INTO source_records t USING (VALUES('a'),('a')) s(k) ON t.id=s.k WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v) SELECT v FROM changed

entries.name: ordered_same_command_merge_error
entries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE source_records SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING id,v) MERGE INTO source_records t USING changed s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=nextval('effect_sequence') RETURNING t.v

entries.name: ordered_insert_duplicate_nothing
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('c',nextval('effect_sequence')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added

entries.name: ordered_insert_duplicate_update
entries.sql: WITH added AS (INSERT INTO archived_records(id,v) VALUES ('c',nextval('effect_sequence')),('c',nextval('effect_sequence')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v RETURNING v) SELECT v FROM added
